title: Reviewing and Enhancing Safety Measures in Marine Sector in View of Increased Workplace Fatalities
what_it_is: Reviewing and Enhancing Safety Measures in Marine Sector in View of Increased Workplace Fatalities

sections.label: Marine sector workplace fatalities actions
sections.summary: MOM took corrective actions after marine sector workplace fatalities rose, and MPA, MOM and the WSH Council called for a Safety Time-Out in October 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Speaker, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) took corrective actions to address the increase in workplace fatalities in the marine sector last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In October 2024, the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), MOM and the Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) Council called on companies in the maritime industry to conduct a Safety Time-Out, with a focus on work activities carried out at anchorages and commercial diving activities.

sections.label: Diving activities code of practice
sections.summary: For diving activities, which caused two of five 2024 sector fatalities, MOM worked with the Commercial Diving Association of Singapore on adhering to the diving code of practice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For diving activities, which contributed to two out of five of the sector’s fatalities in 2024, MOM has worked with the Commercial Diving Association of Singapore to emphasise to the commercial diving community on the importance of adhering to the code of practice for diving at work.

sections.label: Joint enforcement operation on compliance
sections.summary: MOM and MPA conducted a joint enforcement operation from September to December 2024 and will ramp up enforcement efforts this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To ensure compliance, MOM and MPA conducted a joint enforcement operation from September to December 2024, and will ramp up our enforcement efforts this year.

sections.label: Fluctuating marine sector safety records
sections.summary: The marine sector's safety records have fluctuated over recent years, with zero fatalities in 2023 and five in 2024, ranging between zero and five overall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Over the last few years, the safety records of our marine sector has fluctuated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We have had zero in 2023, five in 2024; but overall, it has been anywhere between zero and five.

sections.label: Anchorage activities and diving investigations
sections.summary: Among other anchorage activities, investigations aside, there were drowning during diving works and improper use of scuba gear instead of commercial diving gear.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the other activities in the anchorage, among the other things that happen, investigations aside, drowning during diving works, improper use of scuba gear instead of commercial diving gear, for example.

sections.label: Remote works medical access and first aid
sections.summary: Compared to shipyards, remote works have less nearby medical access, so risk assessments must include support from colleagues with basic CPR and first aid training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As for the nature of works, compared to, say, shipyards, I think you are in a better position because you can have land-based medical personnel nearby or you can be reached by ambulances a lot quicker.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I think for some of these remote works, unfortunately, that is the case and certainly, we will take the feedback to MPA and see how we can improve access by the medical teams.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But we have to be realistic too that many of these works are also offshore, sometimes quite a distance away from land and not easily accessible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Therefore, I think one of the risk assessments has to also include that the workers out there need to be supported by their own colleagues or counterparts who have access to basic cardiopulmonary resuscitation and basic first aid training.
